publishedRecipe.name: Grilled Steak with Strawberry Panzanella Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat. Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Season steak generously with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb ribeye steak
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add to grill/skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Coat bottom of sauté pan with oil. Add bread cubes and, stirring occasionally, toast until golden brown, 4-5 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, olive oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cloves garlic
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 tsp honey
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry strawberries, cucumber, and basil. Trim stem ends, quarter, and add strawberries to bowl with dressing. Medium dice and add cucumber to bowl. Pick basil leaves off the stems; roll them up crosswise, thinly slice into ribbons, and add to bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (16 oz) pkg strawberries
1 English cucumber
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Add bread cubes to bowl and toss to mix.
To serve, place salad on a plate and crumble with goat cheese over top. Serve with steak on the side. Enjoy!
